{{Quote|Time to see who's smart enough to join the hunt. Open fire!|Garnac begins the hunt shortly before Vadoo's death|audio=Garnac-Openfire.flac|<ref name="PL" />}}
'''Vadoo''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned, bald [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="PL" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Vadoo was abducted by a [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|group]] of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] and transported in a [[Prison/Legends|cell]] on a [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|slave ship]]<ref name="PL" /> called the ''[[Vermin-Thrax/Legends|Vermin-Thrax]]''<ref name="Vehicle">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].<ref name="PL" />

On the moon, Vadoo and the other [[Prisoner/Legends|captives]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]],<ref name="PL" /> the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Katt Mol/Legends|Katt Mol]], the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Morgo/Legends|Morgo]], and the [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Lika/Legends|Lika]],<ref name="PLEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref> were dropped onto an [[Island Four/Legends|island]] [[Beach/Legends|beach]] to be [[Battle on Wasskah|hunted]] for sport. The Trandoshan leader [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]] gave the order to begin the hunt, and in response, his minion [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]] fired on the prisoners with the [[Starship|ship's]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. Morgo was [[Death/Legends|killed]] almost immediately while Vadoo and the others attempted to escape. Vadoo ran a short distance before Lo-Taren directed the [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] towards Vadoo, ending the Sakiyan's life.<ref name="PL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vadoo appeared in "[[Padawan Lost]],"<ref name="PL" /> the twenty-first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' that aired on [[April 1]], [[2011]]. Vadoo was identified in the corresponding episode guide on [[StarWars.com]], which also revealed that a scene was written and shot but ultimately cut for time constraints where Vadoo joined with Katt Mol and a hunter named [[Simna]] for survival.<ref name="PLEG" />
